title: AI Anime Pixel Art Generator
summary: Make anime pixel art with AI. Describe a character or scene, pick one of 8 styles from 8-bit to 16-bit, and Flick makes the picture or clip. Try it free.
body_markdown:
### What is anime pixel art?


Anime pixel art is a style that draws anime characters on a visible grid of square pixels with a limited colour palette. It grew out of Japanese games from the 8-bit and 16-bit eras, when character art had to read at very low resolutions.


### Can I make anime pixel art for free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. Every picture and clip on this page used GPT Image 2.5 and MiniMax H3 Fast, which both run on the free plan, and downloads carry a Flick watermark until the Standard plan.


### Is AI pixel art true pixel art?


AI pixel art imitates the look rather than placing each pixel on a strict grid, so edges and pixel sizes can vary when you zoom in. It works well for videos and posters, and game sprites usually need cleanup by hand.


### How do I stop AI making my pixel art look smooth?


Write the rules into the prompt: crisp square pixels, a limited palette, no anti-aliasing and no smooth gradients. Naming a low resolution era such as 8-bit also pushes the model toward larger, clearer pixels.


### Can anime pixel art be animated?


Yes. Use the finished picture as the start frame of an image to video clip and describe one simple movement, repeating the pixel rules in the prompt. Small looping moves such as swaying hair or blinking signs hold the style best.
